281528518.description:
Geoscience Industries
Introductory Earth Science Collection
Rock and Mineral Specimen Study Set
The Geoscience Industries Introductory Earth Science Collection is an educational geology study kit designed for classroom and laboratory learning. The set systematically organizes earth science specimens covering Mohs hardness scale minerals, rock-forming minerals, metallic and nonmetallic ores, as well as igneous, sedimentary, and metamorphic rock types.
Molded grid tray housing individually numbered geological specimens
Includes printed Introductory Earth Science Collection reference chart
Accompanied by Rocks, Minerals, and Gemstones study guide booklet
Includes streak plates, scratch test nail, and magnet accessory
Stored in original partitioned box measuring approximately 19.75 x 11.25 inches
Condition:
